img_477.description: Concentric circular diagram on vellum: a small central disc with a coloured figure, surrounded by two rings of mostly nude women standing or lying radially, each next to an eight-pointed star, with lines of unknown script running around the ring boundaries and short labels by figures. Part of a neighbouring circle visible at left.
img_477.central_figure: A single figure in a blue, pleated, fan-like robe with a blue cap, one arm extended, a star beside the head and a small flower near the feet; gender ambiguous (soft face, long hair).
img_477.sign_reason: A single robed human figure holding/near a star with a flower and no animal or object attribute fits the maiden (Virgo); no scales, bow, jug or twins. Uncertain because the figure could be read as male.
img_477.rings: Central disc plus two figure rings (inner and outer), each bounded by text bands; text also written inside the central disc border.
img_477.figure_details: Nude women, no tubs or barrels; upper figures stand upright, lower ones lie or are drawn head-inward; each holds or touches a star by a line; a few have cloth or hair coverings.
img_477.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, one per figure, plus one beside the central figure; no sun or moon.
img_477.groupings: Roughly 10 in the inner ring and about 20 in the outer ring.
img_477.astro_concept: About 30 figure+star pairs around one sign suggests the 30 degrees of a sign (or days of a solar month); split into rings possibly marks halves or decans.
img_477.other: Folded/joined vellum with another circle at left edge; two painted patches near centre.

img_972.description: Concentric circular diagram: centre shows a clothed couple in colour; two rings of nude women each holding a star on a string, with circular text bands and labels. Adjacent diagrams visible at both edges.
img_972.central_figure: A man in a green tunic and green hat and a woman in a long blue dress, facing each other and holding hands.
img_972.sign_reason: A pair of human figures, male and female, together is the standard medieval Gemini (twins often shown as a couple).
img_972.rings: Central disc, inner ring of figures, outer ring of figures, text bands between and around.
img_972.figure_details: Nude women standing (top) or lying radially; a few lower figures wear clothes or caps; no tubs; each holds a star on a line.
img_972.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, one per figure; no sun or moon.
img_972.groupings: About 10 inner and about 20 outer figures.
img_972.astro_concept: 30 star-holding figures = likely the 30 degrees (or days) of the sign; the rings may separate parts of the sign.
img_972.other: Painted patch covers the lower centre between the couple.

img_896.description: Circular diagram with a central disc containing a coloured animal, surrounded by two rings of women emerging from tubs/barrels or boxes, arranged radially, each with a star; text bands and labels.
img_896.central_figure: A light-coloured goat or ram with back-curving horns and a beard, standing on a small mound and eating from a green bush.
img_896.sign_reason: Horned goat/ram-like animal; no fish tail (so not Capricorn), not a bull. Rams were often drawn goat-like.
img_896.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, with text circles.
img_896.figure_details: Half-length women in tubs, barrels or striped/patterned containers (some with coin-like dots, scales, spirals); some partly clothed with headcloths; each holds a star on a line.
img_896.celestial_objects: About 15 eight-pointed stars; no sun or moon.
img_896.astro_concept: Fifteen figures could be half of a 30-degree sign (paired with another page for the other half), or decans/days.
img_896.other: Half of the sign's degrees perhaps; small reddish stain on left.

img_941.description: Circular diagram with coloured clothed figures (red and green garments, green hats) in tubs or boxes arranged radially around a central animal, each with a star; text bands.
img_941.central_figure: A reddish/pink horned animal with long, upward horns, eating from a basket of green leaves.
img_941.sign_reason: Horned quadruped with longer body and ox-like horns; could equally be a ram/goat (Aries) — horns are long and thin. Choose Taurus weakly.
img_941.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_941.figure_details: Half-length clothed people in red tunics, several with green hats, emerging from tubs/boxes (one with arches); each holds a star on a line.
img_941.astro_concept: Fifteen figures: likely half a sign's 30 degrees, the other half on a companion page.

img_476.description: Circular diagram on vellum with a hole; central red animal surrounded by two rings of mostly nude women (some in tubs), each with a star; text bands; adjacent circle visible at left.
img_476.central_figure: A solid red-brown bull-like animal with short horns and tufted tail, eating from a basket of green leaves, standing on green ground.
img_476.sign_reason: Heavy cattle-like body, short horns and tufted tail point to a bull.
img_476.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_476.figure_details: Nude women, some half-length in tubs (top inner), others full-length standing or lying radially; each holds a star.
img_476.astro_concept: Fifteen figures likely half of the sign's 30 degrees.
img_476.other: Hole in the vellum at left of the inner ring.

img_991.description: Circular diagram with central scales, three rings of nude women each with a star, text bands; a hole in the vellum at right.
img_991.central_figure: A balance (pair of scales) with two hanging pans.
img_991.sign_reason: The balance is the unique attribute of Libra.
img_991.rings: Central disc, inner ring and outer ring of figures, multiple text bands.
img_991.figure_details: Nude women standing or reclining radially, no tubs; one figure at the top wears a crown; each holds a star.
img_991.celestial_objects: About 30 eight-pointed stars, some tinted blue.
img_991.astro_concept: 30 figures = degrees or days of Libra.
img_991.other: Crowned figure in the outer ring top.

img_129.description: Circular diagram with two fish in the centre, an inner band of hatched/brick pattern, and two rings of women in tubs/barrels each with a star; text bands.
img_129.central_figure: Two fish, one above the other, joined by a curved line (cord).
img_129.sign_reason: Two fish tied by a cord is the classic Pisces image.
img_129.rings: Central disc, a decorative hatched band, inner ring and outer ring of figures, text bands.
img_129.figure_details: Half-length women in barrels or tubs (striped, scaled, dotted, green-tinted), some with blue headcloths, some clothed; each holds a star.
img_129.celestial_objects: About 30 stars; two extra stars in the central disc.
img_129.astro_concept: Roughly 30 figures = degrees or days of Pisces.
img_129.other: Hatched band may represent a wall or tub rim.

img_806.description: Circular diagram (top cut off) with central coloured figure, two rings of nude women each with a star, text bands and labels.
img_806.central_figure: A man in a blue tunic and hat aiming a crossbow.
img_806.sign_reason: The archer (here with a crossbow) is Sagittarius.
img_806.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_806.figure_details: Nude women standing or reclining, some with crowns or headdresses, no tubs; each holds a star.
img_806.astro_concept: 30 figures = degrees or days of Sagittarius.

img_489.description: Circular diagram with a central pale animal, two rings of clothed figures in coloured tubs/boxes, each with a star; text bands.
img_489.central_figure: A pale goat or ram with horns curving back, looking up, with a green branch, standing on green mounds.
img_489.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_489.figure_details: Half-length clothed people in red tunics, emerging from coloured (blue, green) tubs or boxes; each holds a star.
img_489.astro_concept: Fifteen figures likely half a sign's 30 degrees.

img_396.description: Circular diagram with central small animal and star, rings of nude women each with a star; top cut off; text bands.
img_396.central_figure: A small grey-green four-legged creature with a long curled tail, like a lizard, salamander or dog, with a large star above.
img_396.sign_reason: A reptile/lizard-like creature with a curling tail is a known substitute for the scorpion; not a lion or goat.
img_396.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_396.figure_details: Nude women standing or reclining, no tubs; each holds a star.
img_396.celestial_objects: About 30 stars plus one in the centre.
img_396.astro_concept: 30 figures = degrees or days of the sign.

img_793.description: Circular diagram with central quadruped, rings of nude women each with a star, text bands; vellum folded.
img_793.central_figure: A spotted cat-like beast with a heavy head, possibly a lion, with a red mark on its leg and a plant behind.
img_793.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_793.figure_details: Nude women standing or reclining, no tubs; each holds a star.
img_793.astro_concept: 30 figures = degrees or days of Leo.

img_241.description: Circular diagram with two crustaceans in the centre, rings of nude women each with a star, text bands; adjacent circle at left.
img_241.central_figure: Two crayfish or lobsters, one green and one red, one above the other.
img_241.rings: Central disc, inner ring, outer ring, text bands.
img_241.figure_details: Nude women standing or reclining, no tubs; each holds a star.
img_241.astro_concept: 30 figures = degrees or days of Cancer.

recognise_source: yes: these look like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), with its unknown script and star-holding nude or tub-bound figures.
